title: Crystal Structure Modeling Tool — Overview and definition
t: Crystal Structure Modeling Tool — Overview and definition
description: Builds and analyzes periodic crystal structures and defects.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Builds and analyzes periodic crystal structures and defects. A crystal structure tool constructs unit cells from space groups and Wyckoff positions, builds supercells with vacancies, interstitials, and dislocations, and computes diffraction patterns. Real implementations include VESTA, pymatgen, and ASE. It validates structures against crystallographic databases.

title: Crystal Structure Modeling Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Crystal Structure Modeling Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Builds and analyzes periodic crystal structures and defects.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Crystal Structure Modeling Tool, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Space-group-constrained structure building). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Space-group-constrained structure building and Supercell and defect construction. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Density functional theory (DFT) calculation package) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
